title: Proof record: one proof job, never changed (ADR 0016; Probata proof of concept ticket 04, 2026-10-14 ET)
description: One record per proof job, written by `swdb prove` into records/proofs/ and never edited. A candidate artifact's level is computed on read from the proof records whose pins still match (swdb.proof). Documented in docs/reference/format-v0.4-proof.md.

subject.description: What was proven. Only candidate_proof_unit is exercised by ticket 04; the other kinds take a text `id` (and an optional `part`) until the tickets that write them give them a shape.

function.description: The function that holds the rewrite site; one call of it is the proof unit.

part.description: A contract-proof part or method part (vocabulary proof_part_names; its subject_kind must match, checked in swdb.proof.validate_record). Ticket 10.

x-required-reasons.candidate: a candidate proof unit names its candidate artifact
x-required-reasons.function: a candidate proof unit names the function that holds the rewrite site

x-required-reasons.id: a subject that is not a candidate proof unit names what was proven in `id`

candidate.x-reason: only a candidate proof unit names a candidate artifact

function.x-reason: only a candidate proof unit names a function

route.x-reason: route is route_1 (direct), route_3 (lockstep) or bounded_direct; ticket 04 owns this field and adds any new value
route.description: Optional proof route of a candidate proof unit (map spec, "Proof routes"). 61 fills bounded_direct; 62 fills route_1 and route_3 and makes it required.

skip_reason.description: A skip: no verifier ran, for this reason (a value of vocabulary proof_failure_classes whose role is skip_reason; ticket 11). A skip record has no verdict, bounds, assumptions or adapter log; the level rule ignores it.

counterexample.description: A refuted verdict's counterexample, inline (small; needed for replay and repair).

unreplayed_counterexample.description: Not proven only, optional (ticket 11, from ticket 05's SAW spike): a counterexample the verifier reported that did not replay concretely on the compiled code, so it is a tool or encoding failure, never a refutation, and never reaches repair.

failure_class.description: Why a not-proven verdict was not proven: a value of vocabulary proof_failure_classes whose role is failure_class (ticket 11; the role is checked in swdb.proof.validate_record).

pins.description: The content-hash set: one pin per kind. A pin that does not apply yet is written as {not_applicable: <sentence>}, never left out.

x-required-reasons.code: the content-hash set pins the code proven (write not_applicable only when it truly does not apply)
x-required-reasons.contract: the content-hash set pins the contract
x-required-reasons.baseline_function: the content-hash set pins the baseline function
x-required-reasons.reference_semantics: the content-hash set pins the reference semantics (or says not_applicable)
x-required-reasons.proof_semantics: the content-hash set pins the proof-semantics version (or says not_applicable)
x-required-reasons.method_version: the content-hash set pins the method version (or says not_applicable)
x-required-reasons.summaries: the content-hash set lists every summary used (an empty list when none)
x-required-reasons.minimum_bounds: the content-hash set pins the minimum-bounds version (or says not_applicable)
x-required-reasons.predecessor_snapshot: the content-hash set pins the predecessor snapshot (or says not_applicable)
x-required-reasons.build_constants: the content-hash set lists every build constant (an empty list when none)

bounds.description: One value or "unbounded" per bound dimension; the thread count is always present.

x-required-reasons.threads: every proof record bounds the thread count (a value or "unbounded")

additionalProperties.x-reason: a bound is a positive integer or "unbounded"

assumptions.description: The assumption set. Each entry: kind (one of seven), reference (ID and hash), one plain sentence.

x-required-reasons.sentence: every assumption entry states itself in one plain sentence

sentence.x-reason: an assumption sentence is not empty

replay_label.x-reason: replay_label is reproduced, proof_semantics_only, not_reproduced or undefined_behavior (O6); ticket 10 owns this field and adds any new value
replay_label.description: Refuted only, optional (ticket 10 defines it; ticket 60 fills it and makes it required on refuted records): how far the refutation's strict-layer replay reaches. undefined_behavior is O6's "undefined behavior (no strict-layer replay)": the refutation counts and the batch goes on.

level.x-reason: a proof record never holds a level: the level rule computes it on read (ADR 0016)

level_rule.x-reason: a proof record never pins the level rule (26 item 9): a rule change recomputes levels and voids no proof

tools.description: Ticket 10 (S14): the verifiers and solvers the job used, each by the reference ID of a trusted_tool entry in the assumption set (for example frama-c-wp-33.0, z3-4.8.14). swdb validate refuses a tool with no such entry. Optional until the real adapters (21, 22) write it.

job.description: The job block: adapter, host, worker_core, wall_seconds, cpu_seconds, batch_load, peak_rss_bytes, batch, position. Ticket 12 owns the field list and its validation; ticket 04 only writes it.

adapter_log.description: The adapter's log in a runs folder outside the repo, on the host the job ran on.

evidence_kind.x-reason: only the scripted adapter writes proof records so far, and its records are contract_fixture evidence

verdict.x-reason: a skip record carries no verdict (no verifier ran)

bounds.x-reason: a skip record carries no bounds (no verifier ran)

assumptions.x-reason: a skip record carries no assumption set (no verifier ran)

evidence.x-reason: a skip record names no adapter log (no verifier ran)

x-required-reasons.verdict: a proof record that is not a skip states its verdict
x-required-reasons.bounds: a proof record that is not a skip states its bounds
x-required-reasons.assumptions: a proof record that is not a skip states its assumption set (an empty list when none)
x-required-reasons.evidence: a proof record that is not a skip names its adapter log

unreplayed_counterexample.x-reason: only a not-proven record holds an unreplayed counterexample

x-required-reasons.counterexample: a refuted record holds its counterexample inline

counterexample.x-reason: only a refuted record holds a counterexample

replay_label.x-reason: only a refuted record holds a replay label

x-required-reasons.failure_class: a not-proven record names its failure class

failure_class.x-reason: only a not-proven record names a failure class

kind.x-reason: only a candidate proof unit carries a proof route
